# P37.28 — Dossier network figures

Ticket: `docs/tickets/452_P37.28__dossier-network-figures.md` (= R11-K13-GX-10 / K2 GX-10)

## What

A per-dossier bipartite network figure per family (access/supply/funding) — the `sig.figure-kit-graph/1` counterpart to VIZ-01a's geo kit. Each figure is a static SVG (wide + narrow variants, zero-JS `:has()` toggles for the access kinds + historical/undated), the H-2 table twin as its long description, and hand-offs to the explorer + the full table.
